caption: Layover workout without changing clothes: Sit-to-Stand from the gate seat, Seated Knee Lift, Standing Hip Hinge, Wall Slide on the pillar, Shoulder Blade Squeeze. Ten minutes, no floor, nothing that makes the row opposite look up. Save this for your next transit day.

overlays.text: The invisible workout. Nobody at the gate can tell you are training.
Sit-to-Stand. 8 reps. Stand up from the gate seat with no hands, sit back down slowly.

scenes.footer: Core. Bag stays between your feet.

overlays.text: Seated Knee Lift. 10 each side. Sit tall, lift one knee, hold a second, lower it.
Standing Hip Hinge. 10 slow reps. Stand, push your hips back, chest forward, stand tall.
Wall Slide. 10 reps. Back on the pillar, arms up the wall and down again.
Shoulder Blade Squeeze. 12 reps. Sit, pull your shoulder blades together, let go.

scenes.footer: Save this for the next transit day.
